message.content:
A structured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit with notched lapels, charcoal grey (#3e4449) fabric.  
High-rise wide-leg trousers in a heavy crepe, straight cut with a clean hem just above the ankle, deep forest green (#1a3c2f) material.  
A crisp poplin button-down shirt tucked in, classic collar, slightly relaxed fit in chest and waist to smooth the belly area, white (#fdfdfd) color.  
Leather ballet flats, soft rounded toe, matte finish, black (#1c1c1c) hue.  
Thin silver chain necklace and simple stud earrings.  

This outfit works because the structured blazer provides a polished professional silhouette appropriate for a smart office environment in autumn weather at 18°C. The high-rise trousers with a relaxed waistline subtly draw attention upward while creating a flattering line over the belly, aligning with her specific comfort goals. Neutral tones like charcoal, forest green, and white ensure the look remains timeless and easy to wear for an all-day work schedule, finishing with understated accessories that maintain focus on the attire rather than jewelry.
